metadata.description: A single Claude Code plugin merging token-optimizer-mcp's smart_*/analytics MCP tools and enforcement hooks with headroom's real Rust compression core (via WASM), plus chop-style Bash interception, transcript analytics, a statusline context meter, session-handoff checkpoints, and TOON conversion.

plugins.name: optiflow
plugins.description: The merged plugin: token-optimizer-mcp's smart_*/analytics tools and enforcement hooks plus headroom's compression core, both merged directly into this codebase (no external process, no npx, no separate binary) - alongside chop-style Bash interception, transcript analytics, statusline context meter, compact-continue handoff, and TOON conversion.
